describes: the robot on the bench supply, 2026-10-19: as built 2026-10-15 (bench box, two XL4015 + 5991) with the Pi Zero W replaced by the Radxa Cubie A7Z and the AC019 antenna in the head cap; Camera Module 3 entry kept (the fitted Radxa Camera 13M 214 is of the same order, not weighed); the bench box's rear lid with its four M2 x 10 is on since 2026-10-26 (Shawn); since 2026-10-26 the A7Z is out of the head on the roof saddle (Shawn): board, header and antenna moved to trunk_base, the saddle body added (V1.33 print, D-022 layout), the Pi-era board screws and the CSI ribbon out of the head, and the IMU, UART, 5 V and amplifier leads re-run to the saddle header from the guide routes

add.source: Radxa publishes no mass for the Cubie A7Z (product brief, docs, ameridroid read 2026-10-19); bounded 15-20 g in cmu/model/sole/README.md; replace by the weighed value. Position: out of the head since 2026-10-26, on the roof saddle, D-022 layout (board x -42.8..-12.8, PCB z 47..48.6, header at the rear; a7z-saddle/build/build.json at commit 2c179f0), PCB centre
add.label: estimate

add.source: Radxa AC019 antenna (1.5 g estimate). Its 40-50 mm pigtail is plugged into the A7Z (CURRENT-STATE parts_a7z_extensions), so it left the head with the board; placed on the rear wall inner face of the roof saddle, D-022 layout (board x -42.8..-12.8, PCB z 47..48.6, header at the rear; a7z-saddle/build/build.json at commit 2c179f0) as designed; where it is stuck on the robot is not recorded
add.label: estimate
